description: A Helm chart for RocketMQ Studio 3.x, the Apache RocketMQ management console

Komga: media server for comics, manga, BDs and ebooks with a web reader, OPDS and Kobo/KOReader sync, with the server claimed at install and native TLS. Hardened by QuenchWorks: nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

RSS-Bridge: Atom, JSON and other feeds for sites that have none, with 400+ bridges, basic auth on by default, an enabled-bridges list and native TLS. Hardened by QuenchWorks: nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
